items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet security controls; blocked for gated-product public exposure. Authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release provenance, dependency controls, data exposure, incident monitoring, and disclosure readiness therefore remain unverified. Exact decision: permit ordinary reversible growth only when existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries are preserved; do not clear any security-sensitive go-live or gated public exposure until material controls are evidenced. This is risk triage, not certification or penetration testing.

Do not retrieve credentials, inspect private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry. Reassess after authorized evidence covers authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container or runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, TLS, dependencies and supply chain, data exposure, incident signals, monitoring, and security.txt or disclosure readiness.
